title: Preparation and characterization of flame-retarded polyamide 6 fibers with hexaphenoxycyclotriphosphazene
washing_state: initial fibers; no durability laundering reported
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Figure 11 identifies pure PA6 and PA6/HPCP-10 fibers; aliquot handling not stated.
source_material_form_LOI_raw: LOI methods explicitly say each fiber sample; LOI mounting or specimen geometry not stated.
treatment_chemistry: Pure textile-grade PA6 control, Table 1: 100 wt% PA6 and 0 wt% HPCP.
treatment_method: PA6 chips dried at 105 °C before use. Single-screw melt spinning through a 0.35 mm spinneret, filtered and wound at 850 m/min. Table 3 control zone temperatures: 270/280/295/295 °C; melt temperature 275 °C; quench flow 1.8 m/s. Results select draw ratio 4.6 for the subsequent fiber series.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Fiber aliquot; sample mass, pan, cutting or grinding and preconditioning not reported.
LOI_instrument: M606B digital oxygen index tester, Qingdao Shanfang
LOI_locator: Original published PDF p.590 (PDF p.14), Flame retardancy of fibers: LOI increases from 23.4 to 29.8 with HPCP. Table 1 defines PA6 as zero-HPCP endpoint. Conclusion assigns 29.8 to 15 wt% HPCP.
TG_locator: Original published PDF pp.589–590 (PDF pp.13–14), Figure 11 caption and Thermal behavior prose: pure PA6 versus PA6/HPCP-10 fibers; residual mass at 800 °C increases from 0.23% to 1.69%.
conditions_locator: Original published PDF pp.580–582 (PDF pp.4–6), Materials, Processing, Characterization; Table 3 p.584 and draw-ratio discussion p.585.
pairing_evidence: The original paper explicitly tests its melt-spun fiber series. Figure 11 compares the pure PA6 control with PA6/HPCP-10 fibers; the residue prose gives the corresponding control/composite order. LOI prose and Table 1 identify the same pure-PA6, zero-HPCP endpoint. No chip DSC value, rheology disk preparation or slope-burning specimen dimensions are transferred to TG or LOI.
source_access_method: Indexed original publisher PDF text; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403 and no PDF pixels were available.
limitations: Only the explicitly stated untreated-fiber endpoint is admitted. PA6/HPCP-10 has exact TG residue but its exact LOI is not available in the retrieved text; Figure 12 values are not estimated. Other formulations have no matching exact TG in the available original. The 10 × 1 × 1 cm twisted-fiber specimens belong to the separate 45-degree slope-burning assay, not documented LOI preparation. Tensile-test conditioning is not assigned to TG/LOI. The filter dimension is omitted because indexed PDF and publisher HTML text differ in the unit, and original pixels are unavailable. Related source DOI 10.1002/app.48458 requires independent reuse review; no numerical data are transferred from it.
